findings.title: Let Metal host readback yield to browser mapping callbacks
findings.ownership: Root-owned native facade, exactly identical between canonical c665 and Root cac; connected bake and application callers #780-owned. No edit authority transferred by reference manifest.
findings.scenario: On browser WebGPU with an already created valid context/device and MetalGpu::new(context,cache), call the public textures(&Metal::default(),MetalTextureSize::try_from(32)?). Tile output is necessarily nonempty. After its producing submit, bake reads normal/roughness via this synchronous helper.
findings.proof: Buffer::read requests map_async and its wasm completion awaits a callback while yielding event-loop tasks. SDK WebBuffer::map_async registers Promise.then2 callbacks that run on the same thread after current execution yields. pollster::block_on sees Pending and waits on a Condvar instead of returning control to the browser; it cannot drive that callback/timer. Thus the public bake cannot finish normally on that route (blocking or unsupported wait panic), despite available typed lower browser progress. This is source proof, not merely absence of a browser runtime run.

findings.affected_sibling: ScalpTextureChain::read at c665 bake/readback.rs:15 also blocks a nonempty Buffer::read; public GpuScalpTexture::read has no yielding alternative.
